issues.title: worktree registry clobbered by concurrent prune
issues.spec: Finding from an overnight run: a global `git worktree prune` fired while a peer build was mid-flight and wiped the peer's admin directory, corrupting its checkout. The prune must be scoped to the run's own worktree instead of repo-wide.

fix_corpus.text: Scope worktree pruning to the invoking run's own dangling entries — replace the repo-wide `git worktree prune` with a per-issue scoped prune so a live peer's admin dir is never removed. Unproven-ownership entries are fail-safe skipped.
Speed up the CI cache restore step by keying the node_modules cache on the lockfile hash instead of the branch name.
Fix the worktree setup script copying `.env` files: it silently skipped dotfiles on Linux because the glob did not match hidden files.
